==Usage==
Copy the template code below for the required usage and paste it into the appropriate place in an article, fill the required fields, and remove any that you don't use.

<code><nowiki>{{TORYouTube|video=|text=|date=|quote=|parameter=|archivedate=|archiveurl=|archivefile=|nobackup=|nolive=}}</nowiki></code>

===Required parameters===
*{{Para|video}} Use the alphanumeric part of the url that comes after "<code>watch?v=</code>" in the url. Please do not include anything other than this.
*{{Para|text}} Title of the video.
*For '''archive''' options, see [[#Backup links|Backup links]] below.

===Optional parameters===
*{{Para|date}} Date the YouTube video was published online. In the format <code>YYYY-MM-DD</code>.
*{{Para|quote}} To include a quote. 
*{{Para|parameter}} To create a link to a channel's playlist, use <code>|parameter=playlist?list</code>.
*{{Para|site_url}} To link to a corresponding article on SWTOR.com that embeds, or is the original source of, the video.

===Backup links===
{{BackupLinkHelp|YouTube}}

==Example(s)==
<code><nowiki>{{TORYouTube|video=fW1-CAtM7XM|text=Splinter Of The Minds Eye|date=2020-12-12|archivedate=20210109034552}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:
{{TORYouTube|video=fW1-CAtM7XM|text=Splinter Of The Minds Eye|date=2020-12-12|archivedate=20210109034552}}

{{TORYouTube|ej_j0cShCOQ|STAR WARS™: The Old Republic™ - First Video Documentary|site_url=news/article/20081212_001}}
